rules.title: Berkeley Annual General Adjustment (AGA) for 2026
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% for tenancies that began before January 1, 2025. Tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 2025 under Costa-Hawkins are exempt.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Board Regulation 1148; Berkeley Municipal Code § 13.76.110A
rules.quotedSpan: the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026
rules.coverageDescription: All rent-stabilized residential rental units in Berkeley subject to rent control, except those with tenancies commencing on or after January 1, 2025 under Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
exemptions: Tenancies begun on or after January 1, 2025 under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act
warnings: The notice does not provide the full text of Regulation 1148, which sets conditions for qualifying and notice requirements; full rule text unavailable.
AGA is an annual order; this 2026 adjustment may not apply in subsequent years without further Board action.

Source is a public notice of an adopted annual rent adjustment order, not the full regulation text. Coverage, exemptions, and notice requirements should be verified against Regulation 1148 and Berkeley Municipal Code § 13.76.110A.
